text: The computation step of the lambda calculus is ___: (λx. e) t → e[t/x], substituting the argument t for the bound variable x in the body.
explanation: β-reduction is the fundamental computation rule, (λx.e) t → e[t/x], using capture-avoiding substitution. By contrast α-renaming just renames bound variables and η concerns extensionality. The expected term is 'β-reduction' (beta-reduction).
